eda.title: Outliers: 3 method(s) agree (consensus)
eda.body: 'age' has outliers detected across the following methods: IQR: 11 (1.2%); Z-score: 2 (0.2%); MAD: 1 (0.1%). Flagged by 3 of 3 methods (consensus - high confidence). Investigate whether extreme values are genuine rare events, data entry errors, or a distinct sub-population. Cross-method agreement increases confidence that these are real anomalies rather than artefacts of any single method's assumptions.

ml.title: Outlier Sensitivity (3 method(s))
ml.body: 'age' has outliers confirmed by 3 detection method(s). Distance-based models (KNN, SVM), linear models, and PCA are sensitive to extreme values. Consider Winsorising at the 1st/99th percentile or applying a RobustScaler before training. Tree-based models are largely unaffected by feature outliers but remain sensitive when outliers appear in the target variable.
